stem: Which of the following statement regarding acute GVHD is NOT true?

options.A: Acute GVHD occurs until day 100 as classical acute GHVD and beyond day 100 as delayed acute GVHD.
options.B: The grading for acute GVHD mainly focus on the clinical presentations of skin, liver, and GI system.
options.C: PTCy is an option for GVHD prophylaxis besides classical immunosuppressive agents.
options.D: Early systemic treatment is recommended for grade 1 acute GVHD.
options.E: All of the above are correct.

stem: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the grading of overall severity of chronic GVHD by computation of scoring of organ systems?

options.A: Mild chronic GVHD : 1-2 organs involved including lung with no more than score 1.
options.B: Moderate chronic GVHD : 3 or more organs involved with no more than score 1.
options.C: Moderate chronic GVHD : At least 1 organ (not lung) with a score of 2.
options.D: Severe chronic GVHD : Lung score of 2 or 3.
options.E: All of the above are correct.

stem: Which of the following description about the monitoring minimal residual disease in ALL and AML is wrong?

options.A: Most frequent recurrent reciprocal translocations are in ALL t(9;22)(q34;q11) (BCR::ABL1), t(12;21)(p13;q23) (ETV6::RUNX1), and t(4;11)(q21;q22) (MLL::AFF1) with age stage associated preponderance in adults, childhood, and infant ALL, respectively.
options.B: High-throughput sequencing (HTS) of immune receptor genes by next-generation sequencing (NGS) is a novel option for MRD in ALL.
options.C: During the past decades, it could be clearly shown by several studies that the level of MRD immediately prior to transplant does have a clear prognostic impact on post-HSCT outcome in ALL.
options.D: Apart from t(15;17) and RUNX1::RUNX1T1 and CBFB::MYH11, currently FLT3-ITD is the best-validated molecular marker for MRD assessment in AML.

ebmt_chapters: Ch57 Monitoring Measurable Residual Disease in ALL and AML (PDF p516–524)
Ch72 Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Adults (PDF p642–650)

stem: Which of the following statement about prevention and treatment of relapse is wrong?

options.A: Relapse has become the most frequent cause of treatment failure after HSCT.
options.B: Beside a direct antitumor effect, TKIs are considered to induce also immunomodulating effects by inducing effect on T-cell cytolytic function, reducing T-cell PD-1 expression, and reducing myeloid-derived suppressor cells.
options.C: TKIs targeting BCR/ABL such as imatinib induce more than 60% molecular remission in CML patients who relapsed after allograft.
options.D: Hypomethylating agents (HMA) lead to an upregulation of HLA and tumor-associated antigen which may be targeted by donor T cells. Furthermore, CD4 and CD8 T cells were strongly suppressed by HMA while a decrease of regulatory T cells has been described.

stem: Which following statements regarding monitoring minimal residual disease (MRD) after allogeneic HSCT is correct ?

options.A: The use of PCR-based method to detect fusion genes can be applied to detect MRD in all the AML cases but not in patients of ALL.
options.B: The method of short tandem repeat (STR) used for determining the chimerism after allogeneic HSCT can sensitively detect the MRD in either AML or ALL.
options.C: In t(8;21) AML, the detection of RUNX1::RUNXITI transcripts may persist after allogeneic transplant without subsequent relapse.
options.D: In AML with chromosomal anomalies, conventional metaphase cytogenetics can detect residual leukemic cells with sensitivity equal to PCR method.
